cape-town-chapman-s-peak-and-cape-penins.slogan: A 115 km loop out of Hout Bay
cape-town-chapman-s-peak-and-cape-penins.story: Cliff road, ocean air and one of the cleanest short rides on earth. 115 km round from Constantia - plan on about 1 h 59 of riding. The stops in between: Chapman’s Peak Drive, Noordhoek beach and Cape Point. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.
